context: Interactive data visualization — zoomable treemap of food groups linked to a parallel coordinates plot for exploring nutritional dimensions across 55+ foods
first_impression: A competent dark-themed dashboard with a custom warm/cool palette, but the parallel coordinates panel is a tangled mass of lines that resists reading without brushing.
what_works: The custom color palette (#e76f51 through #8ecae6) is deliberately chosen — not schemeCategory10 — and creates clear group identity across both the treemap and parallel coordinates. The full-viewport layout with the treemap dominating and parcoords as a linked strip is well-proportioned.
what_doesnt: The parallel coordinates at rest is nearly illegible — 55+ lines at low opacity on a dark background collapses into visual noise with no entry point for the eye. Typography is essentially flat throughout: group labels at 13px bold, leaf labels at 11px, axis labels at 12px — there is no real hierarchy to guide attention.
